name: Chrome DevTools
summary: Debug and profile pages in Chrome.
description: The Chrome DevTools team's server drives a local Chrome: the agent can read console errors and network requests, take traces and check performance. It needs Node.js and Chrome.

probe.note: Invocation from the vendor's documentation, pinned to chrome-devtools-mcp@1.12.0, the newest stable release published on 2026-11-11. The catalog never starts it unpinned.
